# Tuesday, 15 September 2026

**Markets:** Dalal Street reopens after Monday's Ganesh Chaturthi holiday into a hostile setup — Brent near $109, the US 10-year through 5% for the first time since 2023, and Wall Street down on AI-slowdown fears; last Indian close (Fri) had Sensex off 121 pts with Nifty just under 23,400.
**Non-market:** The BRICS summit closed in New Delhi with the New Delhi Declaration and 50+ deliverables under India's chairship, while Mumbai police refused Manoj Jarange's Azad Maidan hunger-strike permission for a second time.

## Top 3 today

**1. US 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% — first time since 2023 — two days before the Fed decides**
A global bond selloff pushed the benchmark through 5% intraday Monday before it pared back, with some traders now pricing a Fed *hike* rather than a cut as oil-driven inflation bites. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/10-year-us-treasury-is-closing-in-on-5percent.html), [Invezz](https://invezz.com/news/2026/09/14/us-10-year-yield-tops-5-as-markets-price-fed-hike/))
Watch: a hawkish hold or a hike lands mid-week into an Indian market already seeing FPI outflows and a record-low rupee — the INR and the 10-year G-sec are where it transmits first.

**2. Oil near $109–110 as the Strait of Hormuz crisis runs into its 200th day**
UKMTO confirmed another vessel struck in the Strait, Oman postponed the Iran talks, and Brent has held above $100 for weeks. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/13/vessel-struck-strait-of-hormuz-ukmto.html), [FinanceFeeds](https://financefeeds.com/brent-crude-oil-price-107-oman-postpones-iran-hormuz-talks/), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/6/us-iran-engaged-in-tanker-war-where-is-the-months-long-conflict-headed))
Watch: this is the single biggest line item in India's macro right now — it feeds the trade deficit, the rupee and the CPI print that just rose for a tenth straight month. Situation still moving.

**3. Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI leaders call for a slowdown in AI development — chipmakers take the hit**
Dario Amodei proposed a plan to slow the pace of frontier capability gains, with Sam Altman, Elon Musk and Google's AI chief broadly agreeing; Micron fell ~5% and Nvidia, AMD and Intel followed. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/12/anthropics-amodei-proposes-plan-to-slow-the-pace-of-advancing-ai-capabilities.html), [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/09/12/anthropic-ai-amodei-pacing), [Reuters via Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/ai-warnings-knock-nasdaq-futures-092329455.html))
Watch: the awkward part is that Anthropic is simultaneously prepping a Nasdaq IPO — if a slowdown consensus holds, the capex assumption underpinning the whole semis complex is what reprices, not just sentiment.

## Indian markets & macro

**Markets reopen today after the Ganesh Chaturthi holiday** — NSE, BSE and MCX were shut Monday 14 September. ([Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/stock-market-holiday-why-nse-bse-will-remain-closed-on-september-14-555318-2026-09-14))
Last print was Friday: Sensex settled 121 pts lower, Nifty a shade below 23,400.

**Friday's close: Sensex −121 pts, Nifty just under 23,400, Bank Nifty a rare gainer.** ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/sensex-settles-121-pts-lower-nifty-ends-tad-below-23-400-level-126091100824_1.html), [5paisa](https://www.5paisa.com/blog/post-market-update-us-futures-gain-nifty-sensex-lower-bank-nifty-gains-september-11-2026))
Oil and war headlines have been the dominant driver for several sessions now, not domestic data.

**August CPI at 4.82% — inflation has risen for ten straight months.** ([The Tribune](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/consumer-prices/cpi-inflation-in-august-at-4-82-yoy-led-by-food-inflation), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/india-inflation-august-iran-war-energy-el-nino.html))
Food-led, with imported energy and El Niño both in the mix — it narrows the MPC's room considerably.

**Q1 FY27 GDP came in at 7.8%, above the RBI's 7% forecast.** ([PIB](https://static.pib.gov.in/WriteReadData/specificdocs/documents/2026/sep/doc_9759_20260901_14422101.pdf), [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.sg/india-gdp-growth-hits-7-8-q1-fy27-economists-question-what-data-misses))
Strong headline, but several economists have flagged what the deflator and the nominal-vs-real gap may be hiding.

**FPIs have pulled ₹13,138 crore from Indian equities in September after July–August inflows.** ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/fpis-withdraw-13-138-crore-from-equities-in-sep-amid-global-uncertainty-126091300134_1.html), [The Federal](https://thefederal.com/category/business/foreign-investors-pull-out-rs-13138-cr-from-indian-equities-in-sept-after-jul-aug-inflows-256497))
With the US 10-year at 5%, the relative-yield case for EM equity gets harder every week.

**Rupee at a record low despite more than $15 billion of RBI intervention.** ([Angel One](https://www.angelone.in/news/economy/rupee-falls-to-record-low-despite-rbi-intervention-of-over-15-billion), [InvestingLive](https://investinglive.com/forex/rupee-nears-record-low-as-rbi-intervenes-but-oil-risk-aversion-weigh))
Reserves being spent to smooth, not defend a level — worth watching the weekly reserves data.

**Stocks to watch today: HDFC Bank, HFCL, Emami, Coforge, Solar Industries, Vodafone Idea.** ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/stocks-to-watch-september-15-hdfc-bank-hfcl-emami-coforge-solar-inds-vodafone-idea-126091500081_1.html))
HDFC Bank added roughly ₹28,000 crore of market cap last week, outpacing the Adani group. ([IIFL](https://www.indiainfoline.com/news/business/hdfc-bank-outpaces-adani-group-with-28000-crore-market-cap-boost))

## India — national

**BRICS summit concludes in New Delhi with the New Delhi Declaration.** ([Eurasia Review](https://www.eurasiareview.com/14092026-brics-summit-concludes-with-adoption-of-new-delhi-declaration/), [Akashvani](https://newsonair.gov.in/brics-summit-delivers-over-50-concrete-outcomes-under-indias-chairship-mea/))
MEA counts 50+ concrete outcomes under India's chairship, with Global South priorities the framing device.

**Mumbai police reject Manoj Jarange's Azad Maidan hunger-strike request for a second time.** ([Punjab Kesari](https://english.punjabkesari.com/india/mumbai-police-rejects-manoj-jaranges-hunger-strike-request-at-azad-maidan-for-second-time), [LatestLY](https://www.latestly.com/india/news/mumbai-police-denies-permission-for-manoj-jarange-patils-azad-maidan-hunger-strike-for-second-time-7604417.html))
He has announced an indefinite stir in Mumbai from 19 September; the city lost days to the last round of this.

**Satya Niketan fallout: MCD demolishes 33 illegal structures and seals 5 properties.** ([News24](https://news24online.com/india/delhi-satya-niketan-collapse-mcd-demolishes-33-illegal-structures-seals-5-properties/924149), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Satya_Niketan_building_collapse))
Figures are still rising as the drive continues — one later report puts it at 67 properties demolished and 9 sealed.

**Delhi factory fire sparks panic; six people jumped from the building.** ([Newskarnataka](https://newskarnataka.com/india/delhi-factory-fire-sparks-panic-as-six-jump-from-building/14092026/))
Second serious building-safety incident in the capital inside a week.

**Mumbai under a rain alert, with the Maratha protest and blast-case hearings running alongside.** ([LatestLY](https://www.latestly.com/india/news/mumbai-latest-news-today-on-september-14th-2026-rain-alert-maratha-protest-blast-case-updates-7603385.html))
Relevant if you are moving around the city today.

## Global markets & macro

**Wall Street closed lower Monday: Dow −0.54%, S&P 500 −0.80%, Nasdaq red.** ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-monday-september-14-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-080559558.html), [TheStreet](https://www.thestreet.com/stock-market-today/stock-market-today-dow-jones-sp-500-nasdaq-updates-sept-14-2026))
Rates and AI capex fears did the damage, not earnings.

**Chipmakers led the fall — Micron −5%, with Nvidia, AMD and Intel down.** ([Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/09/14/stock-market-midday-sept-14-tech-stocks-slide-on-dire-ai-warnings-micron-drops-5/), [Yahoo](https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/news/ai-warning-sends-nvidia-amd-190909953.html))
A rare case of the safety debate showing up directly in the semis tape.

**The Fed meets this week with oil, AI and inflation all pulling in different directions.** ([US News](https://www.usnews.com/news/national-news/articles/2026-09-14/fed-meets-amid-uncertainty-over-oil-ai-and-inflation))
The bond market has moved from "when do they cut" to "might they hike" inside a fortnight.

**Global bond selloff, not just a US story — yields rose across major markets.** ([Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-11/global-bond-selloff-sends-10-year-treasury-yields-to-cusp-of-5))
Duration is being repriced everywhere; term premium is back as a live variable.

**Hormuz traffic down sharply even as the US insists the waterway is "fully open".** ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/9/7/iran-war-live-tehran-to-announce-new-hormuz-shipping-route-in-coming-days))
War-risk marine insurance for the Strait has effectively dried up. ([Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/article/4878166-marine-war-insurance-for-hormuz-dries-up-middle-east-war-intensifies))

**AI-bubble talk is getting louder on the sell side.** ([Fortune](https://fortune.com/2026/09/14/is-ai-stock-market-bubble-federal-reserve-interest-rates/))
"Late-stage" is the word being used — worth reading as positioning commentary rather than a call.

## Deals, IPOs & corporate

**NSE IPO opens this week — price band ₹1,700–₹1,785.** ([The Week](https://www.theweek.in/news/biz-tech/2026/09/13/nse-ipo-opens-this-week-latest-gmp-price-band-lot-size-and-important-dates.html), [Equentis](https://www.equentis.com/blog/nse-ipo-price-band-fixed-check-bid-dates-lot-size-allotment-and-listing-details/), [Zerodha](https://zerodha.com/ipo/411840/national-stock-exchange/))
The exchange itself going public is the structural India markets story of the year — check lot size and the OFS split before bidding.

**Anthropic picks Nasdaq for its listing while its CEO argues for slowing AI down.** ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/anthropic-walks-tightrope-to-nasdaq-pushing-slowdown-and-pursuing-ipo.html))
It has told investors it expects a second consecutive adjusted-profitable quarter; valuation chatter runs from ~$965bn to $2tn, which is chatter, not a book.

**OpenAI has ruled out an IPO this year.** ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/12/anthropics-amodei-proposes-plan-to-slow-the-pace-of-advancing-ai-capabilities.html))
Removes the most obvious comparable from the 2026 pipeline.

**Indian startups raised $7.4 billion in H1 2026, lifted by the CRED–Meta deal.** ([Entrackr](https://entrackr.com/report/indian-startups-raise-74-bn-in-h1-2026-as-cred-meta-deal-lifts-funding-12123065))
Strip that one transaction out and the underlying run-rate looks a lot flatter.

**Q1 2026 funding was close to $4 billion, powered by Neysa and early-stage deals.** ([Entrackr](https://entrackr.com/report/quarterly-funding-report/indian-startup-funding-climbs-to-nearly-4-bn-in-q1-2026-powered-by-neysa-and-early-stage-deals-11445029))
AI-infrastructure is where the large cheques are going, mirroring the US pattern.

**Nearly 90 new unicorns have been minted globally in 2026 so far.** ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/05/almost-40-new-unicorns-have-been-minted-so-far-this-year-here-they-are/))
Concentration is extreme — 17 US AI companies alone have raised $100M+ this year. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/17/here-are-the-17-us-based-ai-companies-that-have-raised-100m-or-more-in-2026/))

## AI, tech & science

**IBM reports a fusion-energy modelling breakthrough using quantum computing.** ([BGR](https://www.bgr.com/2231600/ibm-fusion-breakthrough-quantum-computing/), [Barchart](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3205602/ibms-quantum-breakthrough-sends-massive-clean-energy-signal))
Simulating plasma behaviour is one of the few near-term problems where quantum hardware plausibly beats classical — treat the "breakthrough" framing with the usual caution, the underlying result is the interesting part.

**Quantum computers applied to drug design: light-sensitive cancer drugs win a $2 million contest.** ([Nature via PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41992017/))
A concrete, adjudicated result rather than a vendor claim — useful as a benchmark for where quantum chemistry actually is.

**ISRO set to end a seven-month launch gap with GISAT-1A this month.** ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/technology/tech-news/isro-gisat-1a-launch-september-seven-month-launch-gap-126081800329_1.html))
A geo-imaging satellite, and a test of whether the launch cadence problem is behind them.

**Nature's seven technologies to watch, from quantum computing to mRNA therapeutics.** ([Nature](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-026-00188-6))
Worth keeping as a reference list when funding announcements start name-dropping these.

**AI model releases and benchmark shifts through September are being tracked publicly.** ([LLM-Stats](https://llm-stats.com/ai-news))
Useful if you want the capability picture underneath this week's slowdown-debate headlines.

## Sports

**Asian Games open 19 September in Aichi-Nagoya; India's contingent has had its send-off.** ([The Tribune](https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/asian-games-2026/indias-asian-games-contingent-receives-grand-send-off-ahead-of-aichi-nagoya-campaign), [Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports](https://yas.gov.in/en/sports/participation-indian-contingent-20th-asian-games-2026-scheduled-be-held-19th-september-4th-0))
Games run 19 September to 4 October — the next three weeks are the Indian sport calendar.

**F1: Kimi Antonelli won Sunday's Spanish Grand Prix from Verstappen and Norris.** ([Formula 1](https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/antonelli-clinches-victory-over-verstappen-and-norris-in-spanish-gp.644ZZfPzRPEaUh2JBHcB9), [Motorsport Week](https://www.motorsportweek.com/2026/09/13/f1-2026-spanish-gp-race-results/))
That stretches his championship lead to 81 points. ([Grande Prêmio](https://grandepremio.com/en/f1/antonelli-extends-f1-championship-lead-to-81-points-after-spanish-gp-win/), [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/yaraelshebiny/2026/09/14/f1-standings-2026-after-the-spanish-grand-prix/))

**Tennis: Alexander Zverev is the 2026 US Open men's singles champion.** ([US Open draw](https://www.usopen.org/en_US/scores/draws/2026_MS_draw.pdf), [ATP](https://www.atptour.com/en/news/us-open-2026-results))
First major for him after a long run of finals.

**Premier League: Arsenal stay perfect; Liverpool, Chelsea and Tottenham all dropped points on 12 September.** ([Sunday Guardian](https://sundayguardianlive.com/sports/premier-league-results-september-12-2026-arsenal-stay-perfect-as-liverpool-chelsea-and-tottenham-drop-points-full-results-283625/))
Early, but Arsenal have the only clean record in the top six.

**India's squad for the West Indies series is due to be announced on 16 September.** ([Sportscape](https://www.sportscapemagazine.com/blog/indian-squad-for-the-upcoming-west-indies-series-to-be-announced-on-september-16))
West Indies tour India across the 2026–27 home season. ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Indian_cricket_team_in_India_in_2026%E2%80%9327))

**India's T20 squads for the Afghanistan and Ireland series are already out.** ([Olympics.com](https://www.olympics.com/en/news/afghanistan-vs-india-t20-2026-india-squad-player-list))
Selectors are visibly splitting the pool across the Asian Games and the bilateral calendar. ([Olympics.com](https://www.olympics.com/en/news/india-cricket-squad-ireland-t20-series-2026))

## Worth opening yourself

- [FT Markets](https://www.ft.com/markets) — the 5% Treasury print and the Hormuz oil bid are exactly the two threads FT's markets desk runs best; go straight to today's front page.
- [FT Opinion](https://www.ft.com/opinion) — the Fed-hike-vs-cut argument is the week's live column territory ahead of Wednesday.
- [Anthropic's IPO push collides with Amodei's call to slow AI](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/anthropic-walks-tightrope-to-nasdaq-pushing-slowdown-and-pursuing-ipo.html) — CNBC. The cleanest write-up of the contradiction at the centre of this week's tech tape.
- [10-year Treasury yield hits 5% before reversing as traders await Fed meeting](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/10-year-us-treasury-is-closing-in-on-5percent.html) — CNBC. The intraday reversal is the detail worth understanding, not the headline level.
- ['Crazy days' and 'silly season' raise the prospect of a late-stage AI bubble popping](https://fortune.com/2026/09/14/is-ai-stock-market-bubble-federal-reserve-interest-rates/) — Fortune. Positioning-led rather than valuation-led, which makes it a useful counterweight.
- [Business Standard Premium](https://www.business-standard.com/premium) — for the domestic read on the NSE IPO book and FPI flows once bidding opens.

*Note: search could not surface individual ft.com article URLs today, so the two FT entries are section pages rather than specific pieces.*
